dict.string: Shows what Music, Spotify and your browsers are playing and controls playback.
Changes the volume of individual apps when you turn on per-app volume. Audio is only passed through at the level you choose; nothing is recorded or saved.
Shows today's and this week's events on the notch's Home tab.
Shows your camera in the notch's Mirror tab. Nothing is recorded or sent.
Watches for new screenshots so they can be added to the shelf.
Shows when downloads start and finish.
Records microphone audio with a screen recording when you turn that on in Settings.
Shows reminders due today under the calendar and lets you complete them.
